Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Belis Eshan: 38-year-old woman, 182 cm (tall), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: round full face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tailored-longcoat, specifically a cloth longcoat with a readable waist, split hem, plain underlayer, and fitted shoes; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette oxblood-navy. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
